name: rw-humanize
description: Three-layer defense against AI slop in writing: surface tells, craft flaws, and the durable narrative-structure signatures that survive stylistic editing. Consolidates AI Syntax Avoidance, its craft extension, and Chris Jarvis Voice into one skill, backed by a team of adversarial audit agents. Also includes source-accountability, which makes the assistant show exactly which sources it checked before it says it checked everywhere.
